Maya Chen: Heads up — on a customer private VPC deploy we just noticed audit events getting scrubbed by the ingest pipeline after the RBAC change rolled this morning. KMS routing also fell back to legacy key. Compliance alert fired :exclamation: Anyone oncall?
DevSecBot: ALERT 1777665544 - audit-scrub-detected - severity=high - affected=priv-deploy-42 - rule=auditing.integrity.missing_events - triggered_by=siem
Jon Park: Which RBAC change are we talking about (PR/commit)? timestamp?
Maya Chen: PR https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/changes/2487 commit 9f3a2b1 - temp svcacc scope widen for keystore agent. Rolled at 08:12 UTC.
Lina Gomez: Can you paste a before/after sample of the audit event? need to confirm what "scrubbed" means here (field redaction vs dropped event). Also which component does the scrubbing (log-scrubber vs keystore agent)?
Maya Chen: paste below - pre-scrub: ```{
  "ts": "2026-03-22T08:11:02Z",
  "svc": "svc-inference",
  "event": "DECRYPT",
  "user": "tenant-33",
  "key_id": "projects/priv/keys/rdw-1",
  "payload": "eyJhbGci...",
  "audit_subject": "svc-inference/worker-7"
}``` post-scrub (what landed in storage): ```{
  "ts": "2026-03-22T08:11:02Z",
  "svc": "svc-inference",
  "event": "DECRYPT",
  "user": "tenant-33",
  "key_id": "projects/priv/keys/rdw-1",
  "payload": "",
  "audit_subject": ""
}``` so payload and audit_subject emptied.
Sam Rivera: :eyes: That looks like the scrubber redacted payload/audit_subject. My guess: the temp svcacc allowed the scrub rule to match system-level events and apply full redaction. Also KMS fallback to legacy key could indicate routing table mismatch after the agent restarted. Check keystore-agent logs: ```kubectl -n private-ops logs deploy/keystore-agent -c agent --since=3h | grep -E "route|fallback|key_id"```
Jon Park: Immediate mitigation: set log-scrubber.enabled=false in the configmap for the private cluster to stop further redactions, and pin keystore-agent to stable image (rollback the deploy that introduced KEY_ROUTE change). Command: ```kubectl -n private-config patch configmap/audit-config -p '{"data":{"log-scrubber.enabled":"false"}}' && kubectl -n private-ops rollout restart deploy/keystore-agent```
Maya Chen: Done. Patched and rolled the agent at 08:41 UTC. After restart agent logged: "WARN: routing table mismatch detected, falling back to legacy-key -> key_id=rdw-legacy-01". Found approx 2h of events with empty payload queued in buffer. Kicked off reingest job (replay-control/reingest-2026-03-22). Filing incident INC-2026-42.
Lina Gomez: Good. Next steps: 1) collect keystore-agent pod logs + node-level journald for the window 08:10-10:10; 2) preserve original buffered files (don't mutate); 3) capture KMS audit trail for key rotations and routing entries; 4) revert svcacc scope change and run policy test harness. Also we need to run integrity replay comparing original ingress (if available) vs reingest target to ensure no tenant data lost.
Sam Rivera: I'll grab agent logs and the node tarball (scrubbed copy) and upload to secure-forensics S3 path. Also check whether the purge rule was triggered by agent metadata telling scrubber to remove audit_subject. If so, we need a hotfix to ignore agent-origin flags for cluster-internal events.
Jon Park: Assign to Maya for incident lead, Lina for forensic lead, Sam for keystore logs. Maya — timeline + quick blameless RCA update in the ticket by EOD? :thumbsup:
Maya Chen: On it. Early notes in INC-2026-42: root hypothesis is the temporary svcacc scope widened permissions that allowed the scrub rule to consider internal events as PII-bearing and redact them; secondary issue is KMS routing fallback caused by agent restart using a node-local routing cache. Will attach logs and preserved buffer. Thanks all :pray:
DevSecBot: Incident INC-2026-42 created and assigned - priority=P1 - notify #legal #compliance - retention=7d
